Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1305.jpg'}
{3: 'After a short nap, you leave your room and head toward the meeting location.'}
{3: "Lost in thought about Helentine's odd behavior this morning, you reach the same corner from earlier."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'A familiar gust of wind rushes toward you—'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{3: 'The collision averted just in time, you relax from your defensive stance.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Good afternoon, Commandant.', 4: '1', 18: '100018748'}
{2: 'Ah, uh... Helentine. Did you rest well?', 3: '25'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "The garden. There's something important there.", 4: '1', 18: '100018750'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1118.jpg'}
{3: 'Helentine takes you by your hand, leading you through the labyrinthine garden until you finally arrive beneath a tall parasol tree.'}
{3: 'The parasol tree towers overhead, its thick branches spreading wide and casting a vast canopy of shade. The tree has clearly been tended with care for many years.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'You reminded me of something I need to do, Commandant.', 4: '1', 18: '100018751'}
{3: 'She tosses you a shovel before using hers to prod at a marked patch of soil, gesturing for you to dig together.'}
{3: "Helentine moves with unexpected proficiency, her actions carrying a certain gravitas. She's rarely this serious about anything."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Hmm, the roots are tangled up here.', 4: '1', 18: '100018752'}
{3: "The parasol tree's roots are gnarled and twisted together. Helentine produces a chainsaw and cuts through the tangled mass until a corner of an intact metal box peeks through."}
{3: 'Unlike her earlier bold strokes, Helentine slows down as she nears the box, her movements growing more deliberate. You two work in silence, peeling away the soil layer by layer.'}
{3: 'Removing the soil locked in place by the roots without damaging the fragile package buried beneath requires painstaking precision.'}
{3: "The shadow of the parasol tree's canopy shifts across you as time passes. Warmth lingers even in the shade, and before you know it, it is almost dusk."}
{3: 'Her treasure turns out to be a large stainless steel box. Its surface is severely tarnished, with rust stains and corrosion covering the welded seams.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'A director named Swan buried it with me when I was young.', 4: '1', 18: '100018754'}
{3: 'She carefully cuts the box open, revealing several thick film reels wrapped in oil paper inside.'}
{3: 'Helentine lifts the film reels from the oil paper, examining them. Her touch is feather-light, as though the slightest pressure might cause them to crumble.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "The films have faded. This isn't the way to preserve them. How could I have overlooked something so basic?", 4: '1', 18: '100018756'}
{3: 'A breeze passes through the canopy, and the leaves rustle softly. Helentine stands motionless in the wind, staring vacantly at the yellowed films in her hands.'}
{2: 'What are they about?', 3: '65'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "They're the original master reels of an unfinished movie.", 4: '1', 18: '100018757'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'The family used to invest in the film industry, so we were close with many well-known directors. Auntie Swan was the one I was closest to.', 4: '1', 18: '100018758'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "She's the one who got me interested in film.", 4: '1', 18: '100018759'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1275.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Swan', 3: "Come sit next to me, Helentine. The film's about to start.", 4: '1', 18: '100018760'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Helentine', 3: 'Coming, Auntie Swan! What are we watching today?', 4: '2', 18: '100018761'}

{3: 'Young Helentine lugs over a cushion far too big for her, settling in beside Swan. The projector flickers to life, its beam cutting through the darkened room as images begin to dance across the screen.'}

{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: "Auntie Swan, why does this person keep staring at that person? The camera just stays there, even though there's no dialogue, and nothing's happening.", 4: '2', 18: '100018762'}
{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: 'Is it an editing mistake?', 4: '2', 18: '100018764'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "It's not a mistake. Sometimes, just looking at someone is enough.", 4: '1', 18: '100018765'}
{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: "But I don't get it.", 4: '2', 18: '100018766'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "You'll meet someone ██ one day, and you'll feel whole just looking at this person. Then you'll understand.", 4: '1', 18: '100018767'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1118.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: "The projector's beam begins to fade, replaced by the sunset filtering through the parasol tree. Helentine's eyes refocus on you."}
{2: 'She left these film reels for you.', 3: '102'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "She did, but it looks like they can't be played anymore.", 4: '1', 18: '100018768'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "They were a gift from Auntie Swan, but I didn't know film degraded over time back then.", 4: '1', 18: '100018769'}
{2: 'What kind of movie is it?', 3: '109'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'It\'s called "Deviant Love". Auntie Swan made it based on her own romantic life.', 4: '1', 18: '100018771'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'It was also her last work.', 4: '1', 18: '100018772'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "I can't really recall the details of the plot, though it doesn't feel like I've forgotten them. It's like something was taken right out of the middle.", 4: '1', 18: '100018773'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'But I do remember how she was overwhelmed by grief when she got to the final scenes. She just stopped filming altogether.', 4: '1', 18: '100018774'}
{2: "Here's a thought... Perhaps...", 3: '117'}
{2: 'Director Swan wanted to forget those painful memories?', 3: '119'}
{3: 'The setting sun filters through the leaves, scattering golden fragments across you and the dirt-covered metal box. Helentine glances down at the box in her hands, then back up at you.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Would Auntie Swan really want that?', 4: '1', 18: '100018775'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1389.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Helentine', 3: 'Auntie Swan, why are we burying the films?', 4: '1', 18: '100018776'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Swan', 3: "It's so that it can remind ████■ when you grow up, Little Helentine.", 4: '2', 18: '100018777'}
{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: "Won't it be hard to dig up later if we bury it this deep under the parasol tree?", 4: '1', 18: '100018778'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: 'Some things only reveal their meaning when you work hard to uncover them yourself.', 4: '2', 18: '100018779'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "When you meet someone you ██, but don't know what to do about it, dig up this box together with █.", 4: '2', 18: '100018780'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1118.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: "Auntie Swan made me promise to only retrieve the films with someone special. I don't think she wanted to bury her past.", 4: '1', 18: '100018781'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Commandant, thank you for helping me dig this up.', 4: '1', 18: '100018782'}
{2: 'There should be a way to restore it, right?', 3: '146', 4: 'The WGAA has excellent restoration capabilities nowadays.', 5: '146'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "Some of our family's guests are experts in that field as well. We can ask them when they arrive.", 4: '1', 18: '100018783'}
{3: 'Beep beep beep beep—beep beep beep beep—'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "It's already 6:20 in the evening. I should head to bed now.", 4: '1', 18: '100018784'}
{2: 'This early? Why not grab some dinner first?', 3: '153'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "It's for my treatment.", 4: '1', 18: '100018785'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "If you don't mind, would you walk me back to my room, Commandant?", 4: '1', 18: '100018786'}
{2: "If it's for your treatment, then let's head back together.", 3: '157'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1305.jpg'}
{3: 'On the way back, Helentine seems far more relaxed and cheerful than usual, sharing amusing stories about her family.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1304.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Head Butler', 3: 'Our lady has been acting rather peculiar lately. She seems far more at ease than before.', 4: '1', 18: '100018787'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1305.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1546.jpg', 2: '1'}

{3: 'You walk Helentine to her door and help push it open. Through the gap, you glimpse a room with decor similar to the rest of the manor, except for one thing: the blue modulation pod in the center.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'This is good enough. Thank you, Commandant.', 4: '11', 18: '100018788'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1303.jpg'}
{3: "After closing the door behind her, you head to the butler's lounge and find the head butler just finishing up his day's work."}
{2: "I'd like to know more about that modulation pod.", 3: '184'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Head Butler', 3: "You mean the one in our lady's room?", 4: '1', 18: '100018789'}

{2: 'Head Butler', 3: "It's a custom modulation pod developed by the family. Recently, we noticed our lady has been exhibiting symptoms similar to alexithymia and struggling to identify and express emotions.", 4: '1', 18: '100018790'}

{2: 'Head Butler', 3: "Clinically, patients with alexithymia can intensely experience emotions and physiological impulses, but they cannot identify, name, or verbally express what they're feeling.", 4: '1', 18: '100018791'}

{2: 'Head Butler', 3: "The modulation pod helps our lady process her daily experiences, categorize her emotions, and identify what she's been actually feeling. This alleviates the alexithymia to some degree.", 4: '1', 18: '100018792'}
{2: 'Head Butler', 3: 'Do you think her recent peculiarities are connected to the modulation pod?', 4: '1', 18: '100018793'}
{2: "I'd like to ask her about this in detail once she wakes up.", 3: '192'}
{2: 'Head Butler', 3: 'Thank you for your assistance, Gray Raven Commandant.', 4: '1', 18: '100018794'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: "Meanwhile, the eerie blue light has flickered back to life in Helentine's darkened room after you left."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryShuju.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: '???', 3: "This afternoon didn't yield much progress, but there was an unexpected find... What Auntie Swan left behind might just come in handy.", 4: '1', 18: '100018795'}
{2: '???', 3: "Thanks to Auntie Swan, I think I know how to help you now, Nelly. But I'll need that commandant's full cooperation this time.", 4: '1', 18: '100018796'}
{2: '???', 3: "I'll set the stage tonight. Tomorrow... it begins.", 4: '1', 18: '100018797'}
